questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was pretty standard I guess, I'm on my last year of my BA and I have studied 2 years for another BA before my current BA, so at this point BA level courses are not really a challenge for me anymore, but overall the level were fitting for the students taking the course

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The archaeology department at UiT cannot be compared at all to UCPH. UCPH at the KUA campus is doing everything the can to worsen our experience as archaeology students, constantly changing the structure of the curriculum, shutting down student organizations and cutting down on ressources/machines/facilities available to students... At UiT the archaeology department was superior in many ways.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Arctic Norway and the 3D archaeology course especially if u study archeology at UCPH

questions.answer: My friend took yoga classes which she enjoyed

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Research close cities which you could travel to, go to museums, whatever you like

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was fine, but still a lot of things were different, even though it was Norway, but because Tromsø is so far North, the culture is very different from Oslo which I think is more similar to Copenhagen, Stockholm, Malmö etc.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Just join student organizations/events and participate in the introduction weeks

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Norway is not good at making bread :( also they dont really remove ice and snow from pavements so get ice picks for your shoes in the winter

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: As Tromsø is above the arctic polar circle (?), a lot of activites are focused on happy things (?) such as social gatherings and everywhere is decorated with lights, and a lot of focus on mental health was available

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Bring good quality outer clothes/winter clothes and shoes bought at sport shops or outdoor brand shops,
participate in the introduction week activities, travel while you're living in a new city to other close cities or countries

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I think this depends on the specific person and their needs. A lot of info is available on UiT's website

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: New friends, the courses I took, the travelling I did while living there

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The first couple of months trying to make new friends, and missing my friends back home

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
